display_information.name: Loose Ends
display_information.description: Catches unowned requests and dropped commitments before a person falls through the cracks.
display_information.long_description: Loose Ends is a coverage-gap safety net for mission-driven Slack workspaces. It watches opted-in channels for open loops (work that was asked for or promised), tracks each through a deterministic ownership-and-fulfillment state machine, and escalates to a backup human before a request is silently lost. It uses Claude to classify request-vs-commitment, the Slack Real-Time Search API for an on-demand 'what's still open here?' lookup, and Block Kit cards for one-tap Claim / Done / Snooze / Dismiss.

assistant_view.assistant_description: Ask what's still open and unowned in this channel.

slash_commands.description: Show open loops still tracked in this channel
